mostWorthwhile.text: Receiving the shipment at the clinic was most worthwhile: the local reader and physical passage worked together to get supplies to the door the corporate system still rejected.

leastWorthwhile.text: The two failed intake attempts were the most frustrating passage. It was unclear that the wicket had to be opened and the cart brought through before the configured reader could do anything.

surprise.text: Inspecting the migration monitor automatically combined Moth and the controller even though it listed two partners; the resulting read-only view also made the missing city feed explicit.

arbitrary.text: The ordering around intake initially felt opaque: the released supplies and configured reader both had no available operation until the passage had been opened and used.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: connecting the independent water report across both blocks and seeing the clinic's confirmed receipt close the request made the infrastructure feel useful to the people relying on it, despite the occasional opaque prerequisite.
